name: Punch Card
pitch: Kart gerçek bir IBM delikli kartı: manila karton, kesik köşe, delikler ilerlemeyi gösterir, cevap lastik mühürle basılır.
fonts: IBM Plex Mono 400/500 + IBM Plex Sans Condensed 600/700
portRisk: The clipped-corner card needs a custom Shape plus shadow, and the stamp's ink speckle should ship as a pre-rendered tile. Both are low risk.

name: Rack Unit
pitch: Derinlik öncelikli. Kart, sunucu kabininden dışarı kayan bir blade; LED'ler ilerleme, cevap LED durumu.
portRisk: The blade is a real 3D slab: an X-axis flip with depth edges, a chassis lid seen from above, and drag tilt that combines rotateY and translateZ under perspective. SwiftUI and Compose can only approximate this with rotation3DEffect / graphicsLayer, so the visible thickness edges would have to be faked with extra layers.

name: Blueprint
pitch: Mimari çizim paftası: mavi ozalit, beyaz teknik çizgi, kartın köşesinde title block.
portRisk: Low. The stamp's line-draw uses stroke trimming (trim(from:to:) in SwiftUI, PathMeasure/dash phase in Compose), and the grid is a tileable pattern. Nothing else is platform-specific.

name: Sunday Puzzle
pitch: NYT Games ailesi: editoryal serif, sakin kâğıt, renk yalnızca cevabı taşır.
portRisk: none

name: Pixel Arcade
pitch: Balatro damarı: piksel font, kalın piksel çerçeve, koyu çuha, zıplayan skor.
portRisk: The notched pixel outlines are stacked hard box-shadows, so native needs a small stepped-border Shape or a 9-slice image; the per-letter verdict hop and score pop are plain spring offsets.

name: Arcana
pitch: Kart bir tarot kartı: süslü çerçeve, sembolik çizim, gece laciverti üstüne altın.
portRisk: The 3D rotateY flip with a hidden back face is low-medium risk (rotation3DEffect / graphicsLayer rotationY), and the inline-SVG tarot frame, corners and emblem need to be redrawn as vector assets or Path shapes.

name: Terminal
pitch: Tek monospace font, amber fosfor; kart bir terminal paneli, hüküm bir exit code.
portRisk: The stepped line-by-line print and the ch-based typed preview need a small custom text animator on each platform. The phosphor glow is only a soft text shadow, so overall risk is low.

name: Sticker Brutal
pitch: Neo-brutalist: kalın siyah kontur, sert ofset gölge, doygun düz renkler, laptop sticker enerjisi.
portRisk: The die-cut verdict stickers (starburst and octagon) are inline SVG paths with a white cut line and a hard-shadow copy, so they must be rebuilt as a custom Shape / GenericShape on each platform. They are static paths, so this is easy.

name: Chunky Toy
pitch: Türün varsayılanı, kıyas için: dudaklı şeker butonlar, yuvarlak font, oyuncak hissi (Duolingo ailesi, kendi paletiyle).
portRisk: none

name: Boarding Pass
pitch: Bulutun kelime anlamı: kart bir biniş kartı, perforeli koçan cevapla kopar, ilerleme bir uçuş rotası.
portRisk: The ticket notches are radial-gradient cutouts, which native rebuilds as a custom ticket Shape; the stub tear-off and the barcode generated from the card data port directly.

name: Holo Collectible
pitch: Derinlik öncelikli. Koleksiyon kartı: kalın çerçeve, parmağınla eğilen parallax katmanlar, folyo parlaması.
portRisk: The 3D tilt and flip with parallax layers inside the card is the hardest part, because SwiftUI rotation3DEffect flattens its children, so each layer's offset has to be driven separately from intent. The foil and sunburst are plain linear and angular gradients.

name: Table Deck
pitch: Derinlik öncelikli. Masadaki gerçek deste: kalınlığı görünen yığın, köşe indeksli iskambil kartı, 3D çevirme.
portRisk: Compose has no backface-visibility, so the 3D card flip has to swap faces at 90 degrees (graphicsLayer rotationY plus cameraDistance). The layered three-step card shadows also need tuning per platform.

name: Swiss Type
pitch: Tipografi tasarımın kendisi: dev grotesk, kırmızı/siyah/beyaz, katı grid, süs yok.
portRisk: none. The numeral-to-word swap is a vertically clipped translate, and everything else is flat colour, type and rectangles.

name: Isometric Cloud
pitch: Derinlik öncelikli. Kart izometrik bir veri merkezinin üstünde süzülür; her doğru cevap sahneye bir blok ekler.
portRisk: The isometric data-centre scene is generated SVG polygons, so it needs a Canvas/Path port of the small projection function (about 40 lines). The 3D card tilt plus flip with perspective is supported natively.

name: Whiteboard
pitch: Mimari toplantı tahtası: marker el yazısı, elle çizilmiş kutu ve oklar, yapışkan not olarak kart.
portRisk: The wobbly hand-drawn paths have to be ported as fixed Path data with non-scaling strokes, and the marker circle that draws itself from drag intent and on the verdict needs trim (SwiftUI) or PathMeasure (Compose) driven by the same value.

name: Riso Zine
pitch: İki renkli risograph baskı: kayık overprint, halftone doku, fanzin enerjisi.
fonts: Bagel Fat One 400 + Work Sans 500/600/700 (OFL, 4 weights)
portRisk: The halftone fields are radial-gradient dot tiles clipped to cut-paper polygons, and the mis-registration is offset text-shadow plus duplicated layers. Natively each dot field becomes a tiled image or Canvas pattern inside a clip shape, and the page turn is a rotateY with a left-edge anchor. Everything is reproducible, but there are many small layered pieces.

name: Geometric Poster
pitch: Reigns damarı: her domain için kartın yarısını kaplayan köşeli, düz renkli geometrik illüstrasyon.
portRisk: none: flat polygon illustrations, a hard offset shadow, a Y-axis flip and a rotating ray burst all map to native Paths and transforms.

name: Quiet Premium
pitch: Sakin ve rafine: fildişi karton, boyalı kenar, serif cümle, bol boşluk, tek vurgu rengi.
portRisk: none

name: Certificate
pitch: Sertifikanın kendi dünyası: gravür guilloche desen, güvenlik kâğıdı, hüküm kabartma mühür.
fonts: Libre Caslon Display 400 + Libre Caslon Text 400/700 (OFL)
portRisk: The seal's text along a circle has no native textPath in SwiftUI or Compose, so it needs per-glyph rotation. The guilloche curves are generated at runtime and are best shipped as pre-rendered vector or image assets.

name: Split-Flap
pitch: Derinlik öncelikli. Havalimanı kalkış panosu: cümle split-flap satırlarında döner, sarı üstüne siyah.
portRisk: The per-character split-flap engine (about 120 cells, each with upper and lower halves on a rotateX hinge, staggered random spins) has to be rebuilt as a custom reusable flap view with its own timing on each platform. It is portable, but it is the most engineering of the four.
